constants.source_hint: Ethereum initial slash ~1 ETH + correlation penalty; cosmos/polkadot harder. Estimates.
constants.notes: Estimated slash severity. ETH 0.0312 (~1 ETH on a 32 ETH validator = initial slash) gestures at the protocol's ~1 ETH initial penalty, but is encoded as a stake fraction and is an approximation (correlation penalty can reach 100%). is_regulatory=false (estimate).
